title: Integrate the event-calculated ontology runtime with CyberAlchemy contexts
outcome: CyberAlchemy contexts consume governed ontology projections calculated deterministically from canonical per-node and per-relation events through one admitted business-system bridge and system-runtime ontology, while the accepted W8 runtime contract remains frozen and implementation waits for an exact CAV2-D65 binding.
rationale: The event-sourced ontology vertical proves replay mechanics, but CyberAlchemy still needs an explicit semantic bridge between product contexts and runtime projections. A separate Project would duplicate ownership, so this narrower Goal coordinates that integration under the existing CyberAlchemy Lab Ontology Lifecycle Project.
scope: canonical definitions for the bridge, context selector, event-calculated projection, integration epoch, system-runtime ontology, and challenge routes
one CyberAlchemy Product Capability and one capability-local business ontology for ontology runtime integration
one business-system bridge from CyberAlchemy context selectors to projections at an exact canonical event cut
DomainSpec v2 authored source that deterministically compiles the bridge graph and system-runtime ontology
one exact implementation binding to the accepted W8 Rust runtime and planned context adapters
independent conformance evidence against the frozen W8 contract before any separate admission or cutover decision
exclusions: creating a second Project for the same CyberAlchemy Lab ontology-lifecycle ownership boundary
using Invoke as a construction predecessor, authoring dependency, validator, admission source, or execution route
treating a context artifact, projection, snapshot, compiled graph, or system ontology as a canonical event source
authoring definitions, ontology records, DomainSpec source, bindings, adapters, or Rust changes merely because this Goal is registered
modifying the accepted W8 evidence epoch during integration validation
admission, migration cutover, publication, release, deployment, or external effects
owner_route: CyberAlchemy Lab Ontology Lifecycle Project owner plus CyberAlchemy v2 product owner plus definitions-governance owner plus DomainSpec v2 owner plus CyberAlchemy Lab ontology runtime owner

success_conditions.statement: The existing ontology-lifecycle Project owns this integration Goal without creating a duplicate Project identity.
success_conditions.evidence_requirement: Project and Goal references close bidirectionally, both appear in the Goal ontology view, the Project remains proposed, the Goal remains draft, and both retain authority_effect none.

success_conditions.statement: Canonical definitions and an admitted Product Capability establish the integration meaning before business or runtime design.
success_conditions.evidence_requirement: Every handled term and Product Capability record has an exact identity, digest, owner decision, residue, and challenge route current for one integration epoch.

success_conditions.statement: The capability-local business ontology defines the CyberAlchemy business-system bridge and exact context projection contract.
success_conditions.evidence_requirement: The admitted business ontology keeps product meaning separate from runtime mechanics and binds every context selector to one event cut and exact governance join contract.

success_conditions.statement: DomainSpec v2 deterministically compiles the exact authored integration source into one graph and one admitted system-runtime ontology.
success_conditions.evidence_requirement: Two clean compiles produce byte-identical graph and system-ontology artifacts with current profile, registry, source-set, business-bridge, and owner receipts.

success_conditions.statement: The accepted W8 Rust runtime and context adapters are bound to the exact admitted system-runtime ontology before implementation mutation.
success_conditions.evidence_requirement: A Project-owned ConstructionBinding candidate closes exact artifacts, symbols, versions, digests, owner acceptance, residue, and drift handling without changing the frozen W8 contract.

success_conditions.statement: Independent integration evidence proves deterministic context projections, exact governance joins, W8 compatibility, vacuity resistance, and fail-closed source boundaries.
success_conditions.evidence_requirement: The immutable integration verdict collects all positive and negative checks and remains separate from the later admission and cutover owner decision.

evidence_requirements: Each CAV2-D65 successor must bind the exact current predecessor identity, digest, owner decision, validation result, residue, and challenge route.
DomainSpec authored source, deterministic compiled graph, system-runtime ontology, implementation binding, implementation, and conformance evidence must remain distinct artifacts and authority lanes.
Every CyberAlchemy context projection must declare one canonical event cut and reject missing, mixed, or unverifiable cuts.
A passing schema, compiler, replay, adapter, or conformance check must not imply ontology admission, implementation acceptance, Goal achievement, migration, cutover, release, or deployment.
target_horizon: one bounded CyberAlchemy-context integration epoch after the accepted W8 contract; no cutover or release deadline

revision_history.change: Registered the narrower ontology-runtime integration Goal under the existing CyberAlchemy Lab Ontology Lifecycle Project after PRJINT-1 selected the owner boundary.
revision_history.owner_route: CyberAlchemy Lab Ontology Lifecycle Project owner

challenge_route: Challenge Project ownership through the CyberAlchemy Lab Ontology Lifecycle Project owner, integration meaning through product and definitions owners, business-system bridge meaning through its business-ontology owner, DomainSpec construction through DomainSpec v2 owners, runtime claims through the Lab ontology runtime owner, and admission or cutover through their separate exact owner gates.
